subtitle: Out Manila · China Southern Airlines
overview: Fly via Guangzhou to Urumqi and travel through Altay, Hemu and Kanas to Burqin, with desert highway views, Kanas Lake, Hanasi Old Village and a beginner ski experience at Jikepulin International Ski Resort. Stay in 4-star hotels with an English-speaking guide and a private coach. Quoted for 20 people without compulsory shopping.

placeDesc.S21 Desert Highway: A scenic highway crossing the Gurbantunggut Desert region of northern Xinjiang.
placeDesc.Kelameili Desert Park: A nature reserve on the Gobi Desert edge in northern Xinjiang, known for its wildlife and rugged landscape.
placeDesc.Jiangjun Mountain: A ski and sightseeing mountain near Altay, reached on this tour by cable car (included).
placeDesc.Ahe Highway: A scenic mountain highway in northern Xinjiang leading toward the Kanas area, partly a national highway and partly a mountain road.
placeDesc.Jikepulin International Ski Resort: A ski resort in the Hemu area of northern Xinjiang, where the tour includes a 4-hour beginner ski experience.
placeDesc.Kanas Scenic Area: A remote alpine nature reserve in northern Xinjiang known for lakes, forests and snow-covered peaks.
placeDesc.Kanas Lake: A deep alpine lake in the Kanas area, famed for its changing colors and winter snow scenery.
placeDesc.Hanasi Old Village: A traditional Tuvan village near Kanas with wooden log houses, popular for winter photos.
placeDesc.Fairy Bay: A scenic bay on Kanas River with mirror-like water and surrounding forest.
placeDesc.Moon Bay: A crescent-shaped bend in the Kanas River, a well-known photo viewpoint.
placeDesc.Wolong Bay: A scenic river bend in Kanas known for its small islands in the water.
placeDesc.Wulunguhu Park: A park by Ulungur Lake near Altay in northern Xinjiang, with lake and steppe views.
placeDesc.Devil City on the Sea: A yardang landscape of wind-carved rock formations, near Wulungu Lake in northern Xinjiang.
placeDesc.Xinjiang International Grand Bazaar: A large bazaar complex in Urumqi selling local crafts, dried fruits and Xinjiang specialities.
